name: Harvest Hollow
description: A small pixel-art farm runs itself through the seasons. The farmer tills, plants, waters and harvests a field of carrots, sunflowers and pumpkins, carries the crops to the shipping crate and watches the coin count climb. Crops grow in visible stages over in-game days, the farmer sleeps in a lit farmhouse at night, fireflies rise, and spring, summer, autumn and winter change the grass, trees and weather. Every sprite and tile is drawn in code, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
